con:restMockService.name: PaymentGatewayMock
con:restMockService.con:onRequestScript:
def delay = mockRequest.httpRequest.getHeader("X-Mock-Delay") if (delay?.trim()?.isLong()) Thread.sleep(Math.min(Math.max(delay.trim().toLong(), 0L), 30000L)) // Root landing page so a browser at http://localhost:8090/ sees something instead of an empty 404. def path = mockRequest.httpRequest.pathInfo ?: mockRequest.path if (mockRequest.method.toString() == "GET" && (path == "/" || path == "")) { def r = mockRequest.httpResponse r.status = 200 r.contentType = "text/html; charset=utf-8" r.writer.write("""Mock Payment Gateway

Mock Payment Gateway

This is the SoapUI mock the Pizza Playground API pays through. It has no home page; the API sends you to a pay page when you check out.

  • POST /bills - create a bill (called by the API)
  • GET /pay/<billId> - hosted pay page with Pay and Fail buttons
  • POST /pay/<billId> - signs and posts the callback to the API

Header X-Mock-Delay: <ms> slows any request. See mock-gateway/README.md.

""") r.writer.flush() return new com.eviware.soapui.impl.rest.mock.RestMockResult(mockRequest) }

con:restMockAction.con:dispatchPath:
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap import groovy.xml.XmlUtil def bills = System.properties.computeIfAbsent("pizza.bills") { new ConcurrentHashMap() } def id = mockRequest.path.tokenize("/").last() def bill = bills[id] if (!bill) return "Unknown bill" def e = { XmlUtil.escapeXml(it.toString()) } def action = "/pay/" + e(id) requestContext.page = """ Mock Payment Gateway

Mock Payment Gateway

Bill: ${e(id)}

Order: ${e(bill.orderId)}

Amount: ${e(bill.amount)}

""" return "Page"
